summary: Zoned Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Real Estate Purchase and Sale Agreement for the sale of three properties to Broken Arrow Herbal Center, Inc. Aggregate purchase price is $9.0 million, allocated $8.0M for Chino Property and $500K each for Kingman and Green Valley properties. The buyer is exercising purchase rights under existing lease agreements and will pay $4.0M cash plus a $5.0M secured promissory note. A $400K escrow deposit is required. Closing is scheduled for June 30, 2026, with a potential buyer extension to August 31, 2026, which could split closings. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for financing contingency and close timing.
